title: mimulus kelloggii
intro: Mimulus kelloggii, commonly known as the Kellogg's monkey flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phrymaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Mimulus kelloggii include its ability to act as an anti-histamine and anti-oxidant, reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
